caveat: Measured on a shared machine. Wall-clock rates are pessimistic whenever other tenants use the container's CPU quota (see machine.cgroup_cpu_quota_cores and each section's conditions.cgroup_throttled_fraction and loadavg). Rates per CPU-second remove the time spent waiting for a core, but not the slowdown from sharing caches and hyper-threads with other tenants, so they are pessimistic too, only less. Nothing in this file is extrapolated.
